name: 4D Hybrid Planar-Grid Representation
definition: A representation combining coarse-resolution multi-planar features with high-resolution hash grid representation to achieve efficient and effective reconstruction for large-scale dynamic driving scenarios, lifting 3D to 4D with temporal information encoding.
summary: The 4D Hybrid Planar-Grid Representation is a neural field method for large-scale dynamic scene reconstruction that combines coarse planar features with high-resolution hash grids to balance efficiency and accuracy.
